cited_universal_specs: 2/32 inch — NHTSA TireWise: replace the tire when tread is worn to 2/32 inch, when the built-in wear bars are flush with the tread, or when a penny placed in the tread with Lincoln's head upside down shows the top of Lincoln's head

NHTSA TireWise: check pressure when the tires are cold (vehicle not driven for at least three hours). Use the pressure on the driver's door sticker or owner's manual, not the number molded on the tire sidewall
FTC Auto Repair Basics: after you bounce that corner of the vehicle hard and let go, more than one rebound indicates weak shock absorbers or struts

DOE-HDBK-1084-95: a lead-acid cell's open-circuit voltage is approximately specific gravity + 0.845. Compare the rested pack reading to the voltage or specific-gravity table in the service manual for this battery; this app does not invent a single pack voltage
